target_customer: Originally owners and operators of grid-scale batteries; later hardware fleet operators; the current site targets field service technicians and the contractors who employ them
problem: Battery owners lose revenue to missed market opportunities and compliance gaps, and field service crews lose time and billable detail documenting jobs by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS and services; remote operators paired with AI agents (YC description), voice AI subscription (current website, pricing not seen)
product_category: AI analyst for electricity markets, then remote operations for hardware fleets, then voice AI for field technicians

founders.name: Rohun Ati
prior_employers: Second Measure (YC S15, acquired by Bloomberg)
founders.background_notes: Data scientist and 10th employee at Second Measure, stayed through the Bloomberg acquisition; at AutoGrid he forecast battery revenues; built ERCOT benchmarking software used by battery operators including Spearmint Energy and UBS (YC page). A second person, Bhasi Nair, appears as co-founder only in a directory summary, so he is not listed.

competitors.name: Modo Energy
competitors.what: Battery storage benchmarks and market research, later an AI analyst called Ko
competitors.traction_then: established provider of battery benchmarks; date of Ko launch not verified

technical_complexity.rationale: Market data pipelines and an analyst agent over power market data are standard engineering with domain depth; the current voice agent integrates with several field service tools.

defensibility.rationale: Data products in power markets and voice tools for field service are contested by established vendors; the founder's domain knowledge is the main edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ServiceTitan added voice agents and a field assistant in 2025 per its blog; no acquisition of Dartboard found.

market_need_then: Texas battery revenues were under pressure and operators wanted benchmarks and analysis; Modo reports that average ERCOT battery revenue in 2025 was 84 percent lower than 2023 highs.

branding.domain_note: Started as dartboardenergy.com and now uses dartboard.ai.

identity.voice_and_tone: Voice AI for field technicians that feels like magic

rebrands.why: Scope broadened beyond energy markets; the reason is not stated and the date is unknown

branding.community_and_virality: A YC launch post only; no evidence of merch or community.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found and the common word name was dropped from its energy suffix as the product scope moved.

pivots.from: AI analyst for electricity markets for battery owners (Dartboard Energy)
pivots.to: AI-native remote operations center for hardware fleets (YC description)

pivots.from: Remote operations center for hardware fleets
pivots.why: Not stated; the company website describes this product while the YC directory text still describes fleets

outcome_analysis: Dartboard is active with a two person team. A data scientist with battery market experience started as Dartboard Energy, an AI analyst for battery revenue, joined YC in Winter 2025 and has since shifted its description twice, ending at voice AI for field technicians. Funding is unconfirmed and nothing indicates traction yet, so the outcome is open and pivot risk is notable.
notes: Aggregators list a 500K seed in March 2025 for Dartboard Energy and Dealroom lists a 125K seed; neither is tied to a primary source so no round is recorded. The pivot sequence is inferred from three descriptions (YC launch title, YC directory line, company website), with no dates. Modo source date is 2026-02 (a research page seen in search), later than the batch, so treat competition as only roughly dated. No voice AI competitor search succeeded in finding Dartboard itself.
